bagPolicy.summary: Icehouse hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Park in the lot next to the courtyard at 2528 Nicollet Ave South, the lot on the north side of the building, or the lot at 2518 Nicollet Ave South. If you park in any other nearby lot, you will most likely be towed.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Icehouse. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Icehouse serves a full dinner menu plus premium spirits, house cocktails, beer, wine and nonalcoholic drinks before and during every show.
